items.title: W&L's Mary Schleusner sets two Division III women's hoops records
items.description: Schleusner is still trying to become the second player in NCAA women's basketball history to reach 2,000 career points and rebounds. She says the records are hard to wrap her mind around but mean nothing without her team's support. Shot and edited by Shane Riley
items.posterAlt: Mary Schleusner stands in the Washington and Lee locker room.

items.title: Generals basketball star Mary Schleusner considers playing overseas after graduation
items.description: Schleusner was named the 2026 Jostens Trophy winner, presented to the top Division III basketball player each year. The senior hasn't made any decisions on next steps but is considering playing abroad in Australia after graduation in May. Edited by Shane Riley, with footage shot by Shane Riley and Turi Trainor
items.posterAlt: Mary Schleusner sits for an interview beside a teammate.

items.title: W&L golf teams adjust as course renovations limit practice access
items.description: The Washington and Lee golf teams have been practicing without a golf course since the beginning of the year. The school and the Lexington Golf and Country Club are renovating the course with improved facilities and plan to host tournaments once construction is complete. Shot and edited by Shane Riley
items.posterAlt: A member of the Washington and Lee golf program is interviewed in an office, a tournament calendar behind her.

items.title: Mary Schleusner earns Division III all-star nod as record-setting women's basketball season comes to an end
items.description: After the season ended in the Elite Eight against Denison, Schleusner, the Division III career double-double and rebound record holder, weighs continuing her playing career in college or professionally, and heads to the WBCA Division III All-Star Game. Edited by Shane Riley, with footage shot by Shane Riley and Turi Trainor
items.posterAlt: Graphic of Mary Schleusner dribbling beside her NCAA Division III records: 97 double-doubles and 1,992 rebounds.

items.title: Generals women's hoops undefeated season ends in Elite Eight
items.description: The loss in the NCAA Division III Elite Eight in Lexington ends the team's perfect season and its chance for the first semifinal appearance in program history. The team's seven graduating seniors helped win two Elite Eight appearances and three ODAC titles. Edited by Shane Riley, with footage shot by Shane Riley and Turi Trainor
items.posterAlt: Washington and Lee players speak at an NCAA news conference.

items.title: Generals look to stay undefeated as W&L hosts second weekend of NCAA women's basketball tournament
items.description: At 30-0, the Generals host Bethel, Denison and John Carroll in the Sweet 16 and Elite Eight, expecting big crowds again after filling Holekamp Gym with well over 500 fans in each of the opening-round games. Edited by Shane Riley, with footage shot by Shane Riley and Turi Trainor
items.posterAlt: A Washington and Lee women's basketball player is interviewed in the team's gym.

items.title: Washington and Lee women's basketball team stays unbeaten, advances to Sweet 16
items.description: The Generals reached 30 wins for the first time in program history with NCAA tournament wins over St. Mary's, 73-44, and Christopher Newport, 61-55. Edited by Shane Riley, with footage shot by Shane Riley and Turi Trainor
items.posterAlt: Washington and Lee women's basketball players contest a shot during a game.

items.title: Southern Virginia University Volleyball leans on its young core in 2025 title defense
items.description: Coming off a 2025 national championship, Southern Virginia is off to a 13-1 start, defending its title with 10 freshmen and only one returning starter. Shot and edited by Shane Riley
items.posterAlt: A Southern Virginia University volleyball player is interviewed in a gym.

items.title: Two-sport high school athlete finds home in Lexington after world travel with star-athlete father
items.description: Rockbridge County High School senior Lola Mulitalo, a basketball forward and lacrosse attacker, has committed to play Division I lacrosse at Kennesaw State after helping the Wildcats to three straight 4A regional titles. Shot and edited by Shane Riley
items.posterAlt: Lola Mulitalo sprints past defenders during a lacrosse game.

items.title: Isaac James and His Art
items.description: A 60-second documentary: Washington and Lee junior Isaac James shares his motivation for, and personal fulfillment from, his creations. Shot and edited by Shane Riley
items.posterAlt: A clay horse sculpture seated in an armchair.

items.title: Working Through the Kinks
items.description: Washington and Lee freshman Connor Amorosi and head coach Chris McHugh discuss Connor's and the team's growth during the 2024-25 men's basketball season. Produced in Sports Journalism 210. Shot and edited by Shane Riley
items.posterAlt: Washington and Lee men's basketball players run a defensive drill at practice.

items.title: Offseason Insight
items.description: Captains Colin Ryan and John Loughlin explain how the Division III men's basketball offseason differs from Division I, and how the team works to improve during the summer. Shot and edited by Shane Riley
items.posterAlt: Colin Ryan stands for an interview in a Generals basketball shirt.

items.title: Studio Interview with Thomas Feigin
items.description: Washington and Lee senior Thomas Feigin reflects on his playing career and time at the university, in the Rockbridge Report studio.
items.posterAlt: Thomas Feigin smiles during an interview in the Rockbridge Report studio.

items.title: Washington and Lee University Wind Ensemble Concert "Gradients"
items.description: Highlights from the Wind Ensemble's concert Gradients, with musical inspiration drawn from various works of art. Shot and edited by Shane Riley and Cecilia Roberts
